PCET initiates the radical process and a subsequent HAT relay generates sulfinyl radicals, enabling broad functional-group tolerance and late-stage functionalization of complex natural products and drug molecules.

10.1002/anie.1803920.zh: 该研究通过手性 Cu(I) 配位诱导的去对称加成，将高反应性 paracyclophyne 中间体转化为平面手性 [2.2]paracyclophane 酯，获得高收率和优异 ee。控制实验与 DFT 表明 Cu(I) 配位稳定芳炔型中间体，并通过六元环过渡态引导羧酸盐不对称亲核加成；产物还可经 Fries/Friedel–Crafts 反应转化为多种功能化 PCP 构建块。
10.1002/anie.1803920.en: The study develops a chiral Cu(I)-complexation-induced desymmetric addition to reactive paracyclophyne intermediates, furnishing planar-chiral [2.2]paracyclophane esters in high yields and excellent enantioselectivity. Experiments and DFT indicate that Cu(I) stabilizes the aryne-like intermediate and directs asymmetric carboxylate addition through a six-membered transition state; the products are versatile precursors to functionalized PCP derivatives.

10.1002/anie.6219487.zh: 该研究以 P-手性 AntPhos 配体实现 Ni 催化分子内还原偶联，将带醛侧链的 5-氨基-2,4-二烯酸酯转化为光学活性的羟基四氢异喹啉等杂环，同时构建 anti-邻氨基醇的两个立体中心。NMR 与晶体学表征了关键 oxanickelacycle 中间体及 allyl-Ni 键合模式，并解释了立体化学来源；产物可进一步转化为含氟构建块和生物碱核心。
10.1002/anie.6219487.en: The study uses the P-chiral ligand AntPhos in Ni-catalyzed intramolecular reductive coupling of amino-dienoates bearing tethered aldehydes, providing optically active hydroxylated tetrahydroisoquinolines and related heterocycles with an anti vic-amino-alcohol motif. NMR/crystallographic studies characterize oxanickelacycle intermediates and their allyl-Ni bonding/conformation, while downstream elaborations demonstrate access to fluorinated building blocks and phenanthroquinolizidine alkaloid cores.

10.1002/anie.1324586.zh: 该研究建立电化学 Co/V 接力催化的不对称 Markovnikov 烯烃加氧。Co–H 通过 MHAT 产生 Markovnikov 烷基自由基，随后 V 催化剂进行决定立体化学的双分子 SH2 成 C–O 键；电极分别调节两种金属价态，抑制过氧化并避免化学计量氧化剂，可制备多类手性醇及其衍生物。
10.1002/anie.1324586.en: The study establishes an electrochemical Co/V relay for enantioselective Markovnikov hydrooxygenation of alkenes. A Co–H species generates the Markovnikov alkyl radical by MHAT, followed by stereodetermining bimolecular SH2 C–O bond formation at vanadium; electrochemical control of both metal redox states suppresses overoxidation and removes the need for stoichiometric oxidants, giving diverse enantioenriched alcohols and derivatives.

10.1002/anie.4023427.zh: 该研究以 Ni 催化和配体调控实现异戊二烯与腙的化学发散反应：大位阻、富电子三芳基膦促进 telomerization，而较小、缺电子膦配合 BEt3 则偏向 hydrofunctionalization。腙通过羰基极性反转原位提供苄基等碳亲核/自由基等效体，配体的空间和电子效应决定化学选择性，BEt3 进一步改善区域选择性。
10.1002/anie.4023427.en: The study uses Ni catalysis and ligand control to switch isoprene/hydrazone coupling between telomerization and hydrofunctionalization. Bulky electron-rich triarylphosphines favor telomerization, whereas less bulky electron-poor phosphines with BEt3 favor hydrofunctionalization; mechanistic/DFT analysis attributes the divergence to ligand steric/electronic effects and a regioselectivity-enhancing role for BEt3.

10.1002/anie.1344095.zh: 该研究通过定向工程化 imine reductase (IRED)，用 α-氟酮与胺的动态动力学还原胺化一次性覆盖 β-氟胺的全部四种立体异构体。FRISM 策略在不到 100 个变体中获得四个互补酶，各自选择性生成单一立体异构体，最高 >20:1 dr、99% ee，显示酶活性位点可被程序化调控 C–F/C–N 两个相邻手性中心。
10.1002/anie.1344095.en: The study engineers stereocomplementary imine reductases for dynamic kinetic reductive amination of α-fluoroketones with amines, providing programmable access to all four stereoisomers of β-fluoroamines. A FRISM-guided campaign of fewer than 100 variants yields four complementary enzymes, each favoring one stereoisomer with up to >20:1 dr and 99% ee, demonstrating precise control over adjacent C–F and C–N stereocenters.

10.1038/s41557-026-02212-8.zh: 该研究以烷基肼/磺酰化肼作为实用自由基前体，经简单热激活和 N2 脱除生成烷基自由基，建立从酮、醇、胺及复杂分子出发的统一烷基-S(VI)化合物发散合成平台。无需光催化剂、昂贵金属或复杂装置即可制备 70 余种含硫产物，并可直接后期官能化复杂天然产物。
10.1038/s41557-026-02212-8.en: The study uses alkyl hydrazines or sulfonylated hydrazines as practical radical precursors that undergo thermal N2 extrusion, creating a unified route from abundant ketones, alcohols, amines, and complex molecules to alkyl sulfur(VI) compounds. More than 70 sulfur-containing products are prepared without photocatalysts, expensive metals, or elaborate setups, including late-stage functionalization of complex natural products.

10.1002/anie.9026373.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究将 cyclic dithiothreitol (cDTT) 引入 PET-RAFT 自由基开环共聚，实现耐氧、可控的可降解聚(乙烯酰胺)及其他低活性单体共聚物。仅 2–10 mol% cDTT 即可在主链嵌入二硫键、thioaminal 和邻二醇，聚合物具有可预测分子量和低分散度，并可在还原、酸性或氧化条件下降解，尤其 periodate 氧化可快速断链。
10.1002/anie.9026373.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study incorporates cyclic dithiothreitol (cDTT) into oxygen-tolerant PET-RAFT radical ring-opening copolymerizations of N-vinyl and other less activated monomers. Low cDTT feeds (2–10 mol%) introduce disulfide, thioaminal, and vicinal-diol units while retaining predictable molecular weights and low dispersities, enabling backbone degradation under reductive, acidic, or oxidative conditions, particularly rapid periodate-mediated cleavage.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03843.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以四硫代硫酸钠作为硫中心自由基前体，促进 1,3-二炔二醇的三硫化环化，合成多取代 dithieno[3,2-b:2′,3′-d]thiophene。两步串联过程结合脱水并形成 6 个 C–S 键，为 DTT 稠合噻吩骨架提供直接构建方式。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03843.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Sodium tetrathionate is used as a sulfur-centered radical precursor for trisulfurative annulation of 1,3-diyne diols to polysubstituted dithieno[3,2-b:2′,3′-d]thiophenes. The sequential two-step process combines dehydration with formation of six C–S bonds.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03532.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究通过改变查尔酮中溴取代位置，控制 Pd 催化 C–H 活化/脱羧环化的发散方向：一类异构体经 Heck 环化、氧化脱氢、C–H 活化与脱羧串联生成菲并茚酮，另一异构体选择性生成 9-酰基菲。方法具有优异区域选择性和较宽底物兼容性。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03532.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Bromine position in chalcones controls a Pd-catalyzed divergent C–H activation/decarboxylative annulation with o-halobenzoic acids: one isomer undergoes Heck cyclization/oxidative dehydrogenation/C–H activation/decarboxylation to phenanthrene-fused indanones, whereas the positional isomer gives 9-acylphenanthrenes with high regioselectivity.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03890.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以高度汇聚的糖基化策略合成 Burkholderia pseudomallei B 型 O-抗原十一糖重复单元相关寡糖半抗原。关键包括 α-1,3 galacto-二糖的立体选择性构建、α-1,2/1,3/1,4 交替鼠李糖片段组装及预定位区域选择性木糖基化；所有目标均带 aminopropyl linker，便于后续与载体生物分子偶联。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03890.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. A convergent glycosylation strategy constructs oligosaccharide haptens related to the undecasaccharide repeat of Burkholderia pseudomallei type-B O-antigen. Key operations include stereoselective α-1,3 galacto-disaccharide formation, assembly of alternating α-1,2/1,3/1,4 rhamno-oligosaccharides, and regioselective xylosylation; all targets carry an aminopropyl linker for subsequent bioconjugation.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03678.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究通过催化剂与条件切换，实现 dioxazolone 的中断式 Lossen 重排和两种化学发散环化。DABCO/水条件给出 formal [4+1] 五元杂环；PPh2Cy/一级胺并随后 NaOH 处理则走 formal [3+2+1] 路径生成六元杂环。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03678.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Interrupted Lossen rearrangement of dioxazolones is diverted by catalyst/condition choice into two annulation manifolds: DABCO with water gives formal [4+1] five-membered heterocycles, whereas PPh2Cy with primary amines followed by NaOH affords formal [3+2+1] six-membered heterocycles.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03648.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究通过原位生成 α-benzoyloxy chloride 并由激发态 Hantzsch ester 直接还原，形成 ketyl 型自由基，实现脂肪醛与烯烃的一锅光化学交叉偶联。方法无需金属还原剂或贵金属光催化剂，条件温和、官能团兼容性较好，并可用于生物活性分子的后期修饰。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03648.en: Abstract-based: in situ formed α-benzoyloxy chlorides are directly reduced by photoexcited Hantzsch ester to ketyl-type radicals, enabling one-pot photochemical coupling of aliphatic aldehydes with alkenes. The protocol avoids metal reductants and precious-metal photocatalysts, operates under mild conditions, tolerates diverse functional groups, and supports late-stage modification.

10.1021/jacs.6c08663.zh: 该研究通过定向进化热稳定苏氨酸醛缩酶，建立 PLP 依赖的光生物催化 α-杂芳基胺不对称 α-烷基化，实现自由基 C–C 成键的高对映和非对映控制。体系可构建 α-季碳中心及连续多取代立体中心；光谱与机理研究表明进化促进非天然胺底物形成并稳定关键 quinonoid 中间体，Katritzky 盐则经非常规 PLP 光化学途径生成自由基。
10.1021/jacs.6c08663.en: The study evolves thermophilic threonine aldolases into PLP-dependent photobiocatalysts for enantio- and diastereoselective α-alkylation of α-heteroaryl amines. The enzymes enable radical C–C bond formation at challenging α-tetrasubstituted and contiguous stereocenters, while spectroscopy and mechanistic studies indicate evolution-enhanced formation/stabilization of a key quinonoid intermediate and an unusual PLP-photochemical pathway for radical generation from Katritzky salts.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03627.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以炭黑将可见光转化为热，结合 NHPI/PINO 与 Co(OAc)2·4H2O，在空气中实现苄位 C(sp3)–H 的光热氧化并生成羰基化合物。该方法提供由苄基底物制备相应苄基酮的光热驱动路径。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03627.en: Abstract-based: carbon black converts visible light into heat, enabling NHPI/PINO–Co(OAc)2·4H2O-catalyzed aerobic oxidation of benzylic C(sp3)–H bonds to carbonyl compounds. The method provides a photothermal route for converting benzylic groups into the corresponding benzyl ketones under air.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03503.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究将 triplet ketone 与 Ni 双催化结合，并利用 aminyl radical transfer，实现芳基/烷基溴与烷基硼酸/硼酸酯之间的 C(sp3)–C(sp2) 和 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 偶联。条件温和、底物和官能团兼容性较广；机理研究支持吗啉同时作为碱和 aminyl radical transfer 试剂。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03503.en: Abstract-based: dual triplet-ketone/Ni catalysis coupled with an aminyl-radical-transfer strategy enables C(sp3)–C(sp2) and C(sp3)–C(sp3) coupling of aryl/alkyl bromides with alkyl boronic acids or boronates. The mild protocol has broad functional-group tolerance and late-stage applicability, and mechanistic studies support a dual role for morpholine as base and aminyl-radical-transfer agent.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01739.zh: 该研究发展吲哚与 3,3-二取代 indolenine 的分子间 aza-Friedel–Crafts 反应，使用催化 TsOH·H2O 在温和条件下直接构建带 C3 全碳季碳中心的 3-(3,3-dialkylindolin-2-yl)indole。尽管底物易发生 Plancher 重排，体系通常仍保持高化学选择性；多类 C3-未取代吲哚与 diallyl/dibenzyl indolenine 可参与，二步最高 85% 收率。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01739.en: The study develops an intermolecular aza-Friedel–Crafts reaction of indoles with 3,3-disubstituted indolenines using catalytic TsOH·H2O, directly producing 3-(3,3-dialkylindolin-2-yl)indoles bearing an all-carbon quaternary center. Despite competing Plancher rearrangement, high chemoselectivity is generally maintained across diverse indoles and diallyl/dibenzyl indolenines, with up to 85% yield over two steps.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01564.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究以 AgOTf 促进 gem-difluoroallene 与 D2O 的脱氟氘化，高 E 选择性制备 α-氘代 α,β-不饱和羧酸。氘掺入最高 98%，E/Z 最高 17:1；机理研究指出 D2O 同时作为氘源和氧源，并经 acyl fluoride 中间体。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01564.en: Abstract-based: AgOTf-promoted defluorinative deuteration of gem-difluoroallenes with D2O provides (E)-α-deuterated α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acids. Deuterium incorporation reaches up to 98% with E/Z ratios up to 17:1, and mechanistic studies indicate that D2O serves as both the deuterium and oxygen source through an acyl-fluoride intermediate.

10.1021/acs.joc.6c01206.zh: 该研究以 1 mol% Co2(CO)8 实现羧酸和酯的加氢硅烷化脱氧，无需外加配体、碱或添加剂；在 THF、120 °C 下，芳基/苄基酯约 12 h 转化为烷烃，羧酸约 24 h 完全还原。体系兼容多种官能团并表现出选择性；机理研究支持 Co2(CO)8 均裂生成 Co(CO)4 自由基，继而形成 Co–H/Co–Si 物种并经历连续加氢硅烷化-脱氧。
10.1021/acs.joc.6c01206.en: The study uses 1 mol% Co2(CO)8 for additive-free hydrosilylative deoxygenation of carboxylic acids and esters. In THF at 120 °C, aryl/benzylic esters are converted to alkanes within about 12 h and acids undergo exhaustive reduction within 24 h; mechanistic studies support Co2(CO)8 homolysis to Co(CO)4 radicals, formation of Co–H/Co–silyl species, and sequential hydrosilylation/deoxygenation.

10.1021/jacs.6c14714.zh: 该研究以 hydroxycarbene 作为交叉 benzoin 反应的新型亲核合成子，并通过吡啶捕获抑制其快速量子隧穿 [1,2]-H 迁移，形成较稳定的 pyridinium-zwitterion。该两性离子随后与不同醛高化学选择性反应；质谱首次表征了 hydroxycarbene 衍生两性离子，计算进一步支持其形成与反应性。
10.1021/jacs.6c14714.en: The study establishes hydroxycarbenes as alternative nucleophilic synthons for chemoselective cross-benzoin reactions. Pyridine traps nascent hydroxycarbenes before rapid tunneling [1,2]-H shifts, forming persistent pyridinium-zwitterions that react with diverse aldehydes; mass spectrometry provides the first characterization of these intermediates and computations support their formation and reactivity.

10.1021/jacs.6c13635.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用 Fe 羧酸盐的 LMCT 光化学实现未活化游离脂肪羧酸的直接脱羧硼化，无需先转化为 redox-active ester。光诱导内球电子转移产生烷基自由基并导向烷基硼酸酯，适用于复杂和工业相关羧酸，并展示可放大的 native carboxylic acid→organoboron 路径。
10.1021/jacs.6c13635.en: Abstract-based: an Fe-carboxylate LMCT photocatalytic strategy enables direct decarboxylative borylation of unactivated free aliphatic carboxylic acids without conversion to redox-active esters. Photoinduced inner-sphere electron transfer generates alkyl-radical reactivity that leads to alkyl boronates, including from structurally complex and industrially relevant acids, and the process is described as scalable.

10.1021/jacs.6c12634.zh: 该研究通过流线化全合成重新确定口腔菌 Streptococcus mutans 产生的 mutanolin A–F 结构。关键区域/非对映选择性 sulfenylchlorination 构建带 β-S-半胱氨酸的侧链；合成 mutanolin A 四个 C24/C25 非对映体并与菌提取物共进样，将 A 确定为 C24(R),C25(R)，B 类推确定。对 C–F 的初始名义结构合成后发现 MS/MS 不匹配，随后基于谷胱甘肽生物合成重新提出结构并以 NMR、MS/MS 和共进样验证。
10.1021/jacs.6c12634.en: The study uses streamlined total synthesis to establish/revise the structures of mutanolins A–F from Streptococcus mutans. Regio- and diastereoselective sulfenylchlorination builds the β-S-cysteine-containing side chains; synthesis of all four C24/C25 diastereomers and coinjection assigns mutanolin A as C24(R),C25(R), with B assigned analogously. Mismatches for nominal C–F structures prompted glutathione-biosynthesis-based revisions that were validated by NMR, MS/MS, and coinjection.

10.1021/jacs.6c11735.zh: 该研究给出统一、简洁的对映选择性路线，完成 (−)-ohioensin A、推定 (+)-ohioensin C、(+)-myristinin A/B/C 与 (+)-caesalpinflavan A 的全合成。关键方法包括手性 biphenol 催化芳基/烯基硼酸对 2-hydroxynitrostyrene 的不对称共轭加成、可立体发散构建 cis/trans-2,4-二取代 benzodihydropyran 的环化，以及分子内脱胺芳香均裂取代。
10.1021/jacs.6c11735.en: The study presents a unified concise enantioselective route to (−)-ohioensin A, putative (+)-ohioensin C, (+)-myristinins A and B/C, and (+)-caesalpinflavan A. Key enabling methods are chiral-biphenol-catalyzed asymmetric conjugate addition of aryl/alkenyl boronic acids to 2-hydroxynitrostyrenes, stereodivergent access to cis/trans 2,4-disubstituted benzodihydropyrans, and intramolecular deaminative aromatic homolytic substitution.

10.1021/jacs.6c11517.zh: 该研究开发 (N-hydroxy)amide 介导的未保护肽水相快速头尾环化。肽肼先在 pH 3 亚硝酸盐氧化为肽叠氮化物，再于 pH 8 经分子内 N,O-交换形成环状 O-acyl 肽并 O,N-酰基迁移，最后 Zn/水将 N-hydroxy 还原为天然酰胺键；环化通常 30 min 内完成，几乎无差向异构化和二聚，可覆盖不同序列和环尺寸，并合成 23 个环肽。
10.1021/jacs.6c11517.en: The study develops rapid (N-hydroxy)amide-mediated head-to-tail cyclization of unprotected peptides in water. Peptide hydrazides are oxidized to peptide azides at pH 3, undergo intramolecular N,O-exchange and O,N-acyl transfer at pH 8, and are finally reduced with Zn to native amide bonds; cyclization is completed within about 30 min with little epimerization/dimerization across diverse sequences and ring sizes, and 23 cyclic peptides are prepared.

10.1038/s44160-026-01161-x.zh: 该研究建立 Lewis 酸辅助电催化 oxime/CO2 还原羧化，并进一步把 CO2、亚硝酸盐和芳香醛串联为芳基甘氨酸。亚硝酸盐先电还原为羟胺，与醛缩合成 oxime，再电还原羧化；苯甲醛模型总体法拉第效率 81%、转化率 84%。机理支持 oxime 经 imine 中间体，Lewis 酸配位促进活化/稳定，首个导致 N–O 断裂的电子转移为速率决定步骤。
10.1038/s44160-026-01161-x.en: The study develops Lewis-acid-assisted electroreductive carboxylation of oximes with CO2 and combines it with electroreduction of nitrite to hydroxylamine, enabling a two-step route from CO2, nitrite, and aromatic aldehydes to arylglycines. For benzaldehyde, phenylglycine is obtained with an overall 81% Faradaic efficiency and 84% conversion; mechanistic analysis supports an imine intermediate and identifies the first Lewis-acid-assisted electron transfer leading to N–O cleavage as rate-determining.

10.1038/s41467-026-77983-2.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究将 NiH 催化与 HAT 结合，用 enamide 与 DMF 的 C–H 官能化构建对映富集 α-氨基酸衍生物。反应在温和条件下具有较宽官能团兼容性，产物可转化为未保护非天然 α-氨基酸和其他手性构建块；作者还发现普通硅胶柱可进一步提高部分产物的 ee。
10.1038/s41467-026-77983-2.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. NiH catalysis combined with HAT enables enantioselective hydrocarbamoylation of enamides using DMF C–H functionalization to form enantioenriched α-amino-acid derivatives. The mild radical coupling tolerates diverse functional groups, gives products convertible to unprotected unnatural α-amino acids and other chiral building blocks, and their enantiopurity can in some cases be further improved by normal silica-gel chromatography.

10.1126/science.aeh7895.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究建立线性官能化 1,3-二烯与胺的立体发散 telomerization，通过 Pd/酸协同催化同时控制区域、几何、非对映和对映四个选择性维度。由相同不饱和酯和胺可选择性获得不同 γ-氨基酯；多种新型手性 phosphoramidite 配体用于实现这种多维立体操控。
10.1126/science.aeh7895.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. A Pd/acid cooperative telomerization of linear functionalized 1,3-dienes with amines simultaneously controls regio-, geometric, diastereo-, and enantioselectivity. The same unsaturated ester/amine feedstocks can be directed to distinct γ-amino ester stereoisomers, enabled by newly developed chiral phosphoramidite ligands.

10.1126/science.aef3511.zh: 该研究把通常被视为副通道的三重态芳基氮宾直接用于芳香环 C→N 原子替换，从而避免依赖苛刻氧化条件或单重态氮宾重排。方法适用于萘、蒽、吲哚、苯并呋喃、苯并噻吩、吲唑和 benzisothiazole 等稠合芳杂环，并可在温和条件下用于结构复杂、敏感的天然产物。
10.1126/science.aef3511.en: The study productively engages triplet aryl nitrenes in aromatic C-to-N atom replacement, avoiding reliance on harsh oxidative conditions or singlet-nitrene valence isomerization. The transformation applies to benzenoid rings of naphthalenes, anthracene, indoles, benzofurans, benzothiophene, indazoles, and benzisothiazoles and operates under conditions mild enough for complex, sensitive natural products.

10.1126/science.aec6298.zh: 该研究报道一种新的催化转化，用于将常见醇类底物转化为相应含氟有机产物。研究同时讨论了立体化学控制和反应循环，并展示副产物回收利用的可行性。
10.1126/science.aec6298.en: The study reports a new catalytic transformation that converts common alcohol substrates into corresponding organofluorine products. The work also examines stereochemical control and catalyst turnover and demonstrates recycling of a reaction byproduct.

10.1126/science.aej0194.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以铁催化实现酯与两个卡宾的顺序外球偶联，构建环丙醇，并通过首先形成具有高立体、区域和化学选择性的硅基烯醇醚来控制后续成环。
10.1126/science.aej0194.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study uses iron catalysis for iterative outer-sphere coupling of an ester with two carbene equivalents to construct cyclopropanols, with selective formation of silyl enol ethers setting up the subsequent ring-forming sequence.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03248.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究通过电化学 Rh(III) 催化的分子内烯基 C–H 活化/杂环化，构建由 iminoisocoumarin 单元支撑的大环骨架，可形成不同环尺寸且表现出良好区域选择性。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03248.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Electrochemical Rh(III) catalysis enables intramolecular vinylic C–H activation/heterocyclization to form macrocycles braced by an iminoisocoumarin unit with useful regioselectivity across different ring sizes.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05065.zh: 该研究揭示 Nb2O5 上 Brønsted 酸位与 Lewis 酸位的协同作用可高效催化醇对芳香胺的直接胺化，生成二级胺；催化剂可回收使用。手性醇控制实验、位点毒化、结构表征和计算共同支持两类酸位协同活化底物，并表明主要经过 SN2 型 C–N 成键路径。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05065.en: The study shows that cooperative Brønsted- and Lewis-acid sites on Nb2O5 efficiently catalyze direct amination of alcohols with aromatic amines to give secondary amines, with catalyst reuse demonstrated. Experiments with chiral alcohols, site poisoning, characterization, and calculations collectively support cooperative substrate activation by the two acid-site types and a predominantly SN2-type C–N bond-forming pathway.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03255.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用 Fe(III) 促进的仿生碱基交换，直接从天然 NAD+ / NADP+ 构建 NAAD+ / NAADP+ 及一系列修饰型吡啶核苷酸。策略通过活化带正电的 C–N 糖苷键实现后期碱基替换，为立体发散的辅酶类似物合成提供模块化入口。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03255.en: Abstract-based: an Fe(III)-promoted biomimetic base-exchange reaction converts native NAD+ and NADP+ directly into NAAD+, NAADP+, and modified pyridine nucleotides. Activation of the cationic C–N glycosidic bond enables late-stage base replacement and provides a modular entry to stereodivergent cofactor analogues.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03147.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究发展光氧化还原催化的自由基杂环化，将带烯烃的羧酸或磺酰胺与 α-碘鎓重氮化合物偶联，得到保留重氮基团的内酯或吡咯烷产物。摘要还报告克级反应和后续衍生化，并提出自由基-极性交叉参与成环。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03147.en: Abstract-based: photoredox-catalyzed radical heterocyclization couples alkene-tethered carboxylic acids or sulfonamides with α-iodonium diazo compounds to form lactone or pyrrolidine products while retaining the diazo group. The abstract also reports gram-scale operation and downstream derivatization and proposes radical–polar crossover in the cyclization sequence.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03822.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究实现 1,3-烯炔、4-烷基 Hantzsch 酯与 CO2 的可见光 1,4-烷基化/羧化，一步合成四取代 2,3-联烯酸。Hantzsch 酯作为烷基自由基前体，方法具有良好官能团兼容性，并展示放大与产物衍生化。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03822.en: Abstract-based: visible-light 1,4-alkylation/carboxylation of 1,3-enynes with 4-alkyl Hantzsch esters and CO2 provides tetrasubstituted 2,3-allenoic acids in one operation. Hantzsch esters serve as alkyl-radical precursors, and the abstract reports useful functional-group tolerance, scale-up, and product derivatization.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03505.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以甲酸盐为还原性碳源，在无需外加光催化剂或过渡金属的条件下，实现芳基炔的芳基羧化/环化/氢化级联，构建含酯基的二氧二氢二苯并噻氮杂卓衍生物。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03505.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Using formate as a reductive carbon source, the study performs an arylcarboxylation/cyclization/hydrogenation cascade of arylalkynes without an added photocatalyst or transition metal to access ester-substituted dioxodihydrodibenzothiazepine derivatives.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03072.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究将 aldolase NahE 与 benzoylformate decarboxylase 组合，生物催化合成取代肉桂醛。该级联拓展了 TPP 依赖脱羧酶对 α,β-不饱和 2-氧代酸的利用，并显示供电子取代苯甲醛通常优于吸电子底物。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03072.en: Abstract-based: the study combines the aldolase NahE with benzoylformate decarboxylase for biocatalytic synthesis of substituted cinnamaldehydes. The cascade expands the use of α,β-unsaturated 2-oxo acids with a TPP-dependent decarboxylase and indicates that electron-rich benzaldehydes generally perform better than electron-poor analogues.

10.1021/acscatal.6c05381.zh: 该研究建立 sequence-to-scaffold 平台，把酶序列筛选与位点特异性固定化连接起来，用于载体支持的核苷类似物生物催化。通过多参数酶挖掘和 agarose-HPMC 支架上的可控固定，作者调节酶密度、可接近性和稳定性，并以正交蛋白偶联对双酶级联进行空间计量组织。
10.1021/acscatal.6c05381.en: The study establishes a sequence-to-scaffold platform that links enzyme mining with site-specific immobilization for carrier-supported synthesis of nucleoside analogues. Multiparameter enzyme selection and controlled immobilization on agarose-HPMC scaffolds tune enzyme density, accessibility, and stability, while orthogonal protein-coupling pairs organize two-enzyme cascades with defined stoichiometry.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03740.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究发展无需外加还原剂的可见光 Davis–Beirut 型反应，由 o-硝基苯甲醛亚胺直接生成 indazolin-3-one。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03740.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study develops a reductant-free visible-light Davis–Beirut-type transformation of o-nitrobenzaldimines to indazolin-3-ones.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03340.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究报道铜催化 1,6-二炔与 1H-indole-2-ethanol 的形式 [5+1] 环化，构建 tetrahydropyranoindole 骨架。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03340.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Copper catalysis enables a formal [5+1] annulation of 1,6-diynes with 1H-indole-2-ethanols to construct tetrahydropyranoindole frameworks.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03335.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以 Rh(III) 催化 2-苯基苯并咪唑与可异构化 3-甲基马来酰亚胺的 [4+2] spiroannulation，构建螺环多环产物。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03335.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Rh(III) catalysis promotes [4+2] spiroannulation of 2-phenylbenzimidazoles with isomerizable 3-methylmaleimides to form spirocyclic polycycles.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03243.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究利用 iodomethylboronic ester 在 PBS 水相中快速双烷基化，将肽中的 cysteine 转化为 dehydroalanine，并将 penicillamine 转化为 dehydrovaline。生成的烯烃位点可进一步与硫醇类载荷共轭，为药物、脂质、荧光团和谷胱甘肽等后期接枝提供通用入口。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03243.en: Abstract-based: rapid bis-alkylation with iodomethylboronic ester in aqueous PBS converts cysteine residues in peptides to dehydroalanine and penicillamine to dehydrovaline. The resulting alkene handles can undergo further thiol conjugation, providing a general entry to late-stage attachment of drug, lipid, fluorophore, and glutathione cargoes.

10.1002/anie.3574678.zh: 该研究将光氧化还原与 Ni 催化结合，实现烷基芳烃苄位 C–H 的无受体脱氢烷氧羰基化，构建苄基酯、benzofuranone 和 lactone，并以 H2 作为唯一化学计量副产物。双膦配体被用于促进 acyl-Ni(II) 与醇的还原消除，同时抑制不利的单电子氧化加成。
10.1002/anie.3574678.en: The study combines photoredox and nickel catalysis for acceptorless dehydrogenative alkoxycarbonylation of benzylic C–H bonds, providing benzylic esters, benzofuranones, and lactones with H2 as the stoichiometric byproduct. A bisphosphine ligand promotes reductive elimination between an acyl-Ni(II) species and alcohol while suppressing an undesired single-electron oxidative-addition pathway.

10.1002/anie.2539581.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究发展温和、模块化的 late-stage annulative imidazolation，可在近中性的水相条件下把组氨酸类似侧链直接安装到肽和蛋白上。
10.1002/anie.2539581.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study develops a mild, modular late-stage annulative imidazolation that installs histidine-analogous side chains directly on peptides and proteins under near-neutral aqueous conditions.

10.1002/anie.5617321.zh: 该研究提出 silylium 离子/Pd 协同催化的 Heck 型迁移烯烃硅基化，以 allylsilane 作为化学计量硅亲电试剂，将末端烯烃转化为 E-allylsilane。机理研究和计算支持先形成阳离子 silylpalladium 物种，再经历区域选择性离子加成、β-H 消除与 Pd–H 循环；随后 allylsilane 的质解把质子等效体重新转移给 silylium 催化剂。
10.1002/anie.5617321.en: The study introduces synergistic silylium-ion/Pd catalysis for Heck-type migratory silylation of terminal alkenes, using an allylsilane as the stoichiometric silicon electrophile to form E-allylsilanes. Mechanistic studies and calculations support a cationic silylpalladium species followed by regioselective ionic addition, β-H elimination, and a Pd–H manifold, with allylsilane protolysis transferring the proton equivalent back to the silylium cycle.

10.1002/anie.6992524.zh: 该研究把光诱导 N 原子删除嵌入经典 N-allylation，实现一级烷基胺的脱胺烯丙基化，直接生成 α-取代丙烯酸酯和丙烯酰胺。机理研究显示多个并行路径可汇聚到共同产物，包括直接脱胺烯丙基化、烯丙胺的 N 删除以及烯丙基烷基二氮烯的脱氮。
10.1002/anie.6992524.en: The study embeds photoinduced nitrogen-atom deletion into a classical N-allylation manifold to achieve deaminative allylation of primary alkylamines, directly furnishing α-substituted acrylates and acrylamides. Mechanistic studies reveal multiple convergent pathways, including direct deaminative allylation, nitrogen deletion from allylamines, and denitrogenation of allyl alkyldiazenes.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03701.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究使用 redox-active aryl-BIAN 有机自由基阴离子催化剂，在空气中把 arylmethanamine 氧化为相应酰胺，避免昂贵过渡金属和强氧化试剂。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03701.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. A redox-active aryl-BIAN organic radical-anion catalyst enables aerobic conversion of arylmethanamines to the corresponding amides without an expensive transition metal or strongly reactive oxidant.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03647.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以光氧化还原/Co 双催化实现未活化 1,3-烯炔的区域选择性 1,2-hydroamination，直接合成 propargylamine。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03647.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Dual photoredox/cobalt catalysis enables regioselective 1,2-hydroamination of unactivated 1,3-enynes to give propargylamines.

10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03497.zh: 基于 Abstract：该研究从 bicyclo[1.1.0]butane carboxylic acid 出发，发展互补的极性与电化学 strain-release 策略，模块化合成 1,4-双官能化 2-oxabicyclo[2.1.1]hexan-3-one。两种活化模式共同拓展这一饱和芳环替代骨架的可达化学空间。
10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03497.en: Abstract-based: complementary polar and electrochemical strain-release strategies convert bicyclo[1.1.0]butane carboxylic acids into modular 1,4-difunctionalized 2-oxabicyclo[2.1.1]hexan-3-ones. The two activation modes expand accessible chemical space around this saturated aromatic-replacement scaffold.

10.1002/anie.5070160.zh: 该研究报道 Pd–vinylidene 对 B–H 键的催化插入，以 alkynyl hypervalent iodine 作为不饱和卡宾前体、amine–borane 作为硼源，高立体选择性合成 E-alkenyl monoboronate。反应兼容芳基、杂芳基和脂肪族取代，并可放大；所得单硼酸酯还能继续进行多类 C–X 成键。
10.1002/anie.5070160.en: The study reports catalytic insertion of Pd–vinylidenes into B–H bonds, using alkynyl hypervalent iodine reagents as unsaturated-carbene precursors and amine–boranes as boron sources to form E-alkenyl monoboronates with high stereoselectivity. Aromatic, heteroaromatic, and aliphatic substituents are tolerated, the reaction is scalable, and the products undergo diverse C–X bond-forming transformations.

10.1002/anie.4582039.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究利用 redox-active oxazino-pyridine 中间体实现吡啶 meta 位的亲核官能化，解决常规极性条件下的亲核试剂/吡啶 meta 位极性错配。
10.1002/anie.4582039.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Redox-active oxazino-pyridine intermediates enable nucleophilic meta-functionalization of pyridines, overcoming the usual polarity mismatch at that position.

10.1002/anie.8789956.zh: 该研究通过一步分子间氧化偶联/环脱水构建 B,N,O 嵌入的 hetero[9]helicene，显著缩短多杂原子 helicene 的合成路线。所得 BNFN 兼具稳定纯绿色发光与圆偏振发光，并可进一步用于器件研究。
10.1002/anie.8789956.en: The study uses a one-step intermolecular oxidative coupling/cyclodehydration to construct a B,N,O-embedded hetero[9]helicene, substantially simplifying access to a multiply heteroatom-doped helicene framework. The resulting BNFN combines stable pure-green emission with circularly polarized luminescence and is further evaluated in devices.

10.1002/anie.7101768.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以 anion-binding catalysis 实现 cyclic acetal 的可逆失活阳离子开环聚合，制备端基受控的 polyacetal polyol，并进一步用于可化学回收的 polyurethane。
10.1002/anie.7101768.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Anion-binding catalysis enables reversible-deactivation cationic ring-opening polymerization of cyclic acetals to produce controlled polyacetal polyols that are subsequently incorporated into chemically recyclable polyurethanes.

10.1002/anie.5041475.zh: 该研究建立 Fe/disulfide 协同光催化框架，实现 fluoroalcohol 对烯烃的发散加成，并以 DMSO 作为外源调控因子切换产物类型。Fe-LMCT 产生 fluoroalkoxy radical 后，可直接发生 O-radical 加成形成 fluoroether，或在 DMSO 参与下经 1,2-HAT 转入 C-centered radical 路径生成 fluoroalcohol 加成产物。
10.1002/anie.5041475.en: The study establishes cooperative Fe/disulfide photocatalysis for divergent addition of fluoroalcohols to alkenes, with DMSO acting as an external switch between product manifolds. Fe-LMCT generates fluoroalkoxy radicals that can undergo direct O-radical addition to form fluoroethers or, with DMSO participation, enter a 1,2-HAT pathway to carbon-centered radicals and fluoroalcohol-addition products.

10.1002/anie.2218878.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究将可编辑 N/O-glycan 前体的化学合成与酶促 sialylation/fucosylation 结合，建立 branch-selective sulfated glycan 的化学酶法组装平台。
10.1002/anie.2218878.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study combines chemical synthesis of editable N/O-glycan precursors with enzymatic sialylation and fucosylation to assemble branch-selectively sulfated glycans.

10.1002/anie.8651160.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究发现 tetraarylated biazulene 在 Scholl 反应中发生意外 azulene→phenanthrene 重排，并据此高效构建不同 nanographene。
10.1002/anie.8651160.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. An unexpected azulene-to-phenanthrene rearrangement occurs during Scholl reactions of tetraarylated biazulenes and is exploited for efficient access to distinct nanographenes.

10.1002/anie.5796773.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以 Pd/Zn 催化 cyclopropanol 与 allyl acetate 的形式“allylic cyclopropylation”，通过暂时开环生成 enolized homoenolate、截获 π-allylpalladium 后重新闭环，从而在形成新 C–C 键的同时保留 cyclopropane。
10.1002/anie.5796773.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Pd/Zn catalysis enables a formal allylic cyclopropylation of cyclopropanols with allyl acetates through transient ring opening to an enolized homoenolate, interception by π-allylpalladium, and ring closure that preserves the cyclopropane while forming a new C–C bond.

10.1002/anie.8911828.zh: 该研究以 Rh 催化 phenoxyalkyne 与 1,6-diyne 的 atroposelective [2+2+2] annulation，一步构建具有 C–O 手性轴的 diaryl ether。方法无需预制手性底物即可获得高对映控制和良好化学选择性，并可将产物进一步转化为手性配体和合成砌块。
10.1002/anie.8911828.en: The study uses Rh-catalyzed atroposelective [2+2+2] annulation of phenoxyalkynes with 1,6-diynes to construct diaryl ethers bearing C–O chiral axes in one step. High enantiocontrol and chemoselectivity are achieved without preassembled chiral substrates, and the products can be converted into chiral ligands and synthetic building blocks.

10.1002/anie.5852828.zh: 该研究通过 de novo 蛋白设计构建可结合 Mn(salen) 的人工金属酶，用于不对称 sulfoxidation，并通过结构解析和理性突变进一步提高催化性能与对映选择性。高分辨率蛋白结构揭示非天然辅因子的结合环境，随后围绕活性位点的定向优化改善产率和 e.r.，并扩展到多类硫醚底物。
10.1002/anie.5852828.en: The study uses de novo protein design to create artificial metalloenzymes that bind Mn(salen) complexes for asymmetric sulfoxidation, followed by structure-guided optimization to improve activity and enantioselectivity. A high-resolution protein structure defines the environment of the non-native cofactor, and rational mutations around the active site improve yield and e.r.

10.1002/anie.4084841.zh: 该研究发展锂介导的 mechanochemical 策略，实现 furan 内环氧原子的发散单原子转化。球磨条件下先形成 deoxygenatively dilithiated 中间体，再与不同亲电试剂反应，可把原 O 位替换为 Si、C、Se、P、Ge 或 Ti 等元素，获得多类异构骨架。
10.1002/anie.4084841.en: The study develops a lithium-mediated mechanochemical strategy for divergent single-atom transmutation of the endocyclic oxygen in furans. Ball milling generates deoxygenatively dilithiated intermediates that react with different electrophiles, allowing the original oxygen site to be replaced by elements such as Si, C, Se, P, Ge, or Ti to access diverse frameworks.

10.1002/anie.3092581.zh: 该研究以 Pd 催化不对称 Suzuki–Miyaura 偶联构建 inherently chiral dibenzo[a,e]cyclooctatetraene (dbCOT) diene，并实现高对映选择性。机理研究表明立体选择来源于顺序进行的动态动力学不对称转化和后续 enantioenrichment。
10.1002/anie.3092581.en: The study uses Pd-catalyzed asymmetric Suzuki–Miyaura coupling to construct inherently chiral dibenzo[a,e]cyclooctatetraene (dbCOT) dienes with high enantioselectivity. Mechanistic studies attribute stereocontrol to sequential dynamic kinetic asymmetric transformation and subsequent enantioenrichment.

10.1002/anie.9519061.zh: 该研究通过对 pyridylamido-Hf 催化剂活性位点进行预调控，使原本难聚合的高位阻 α-olefin 可发生高选择性聚合，并获得超高熔点 polyolefin。利用 allyltrimethylsilane 对活性位点的精细调节后，体系可处理 vinylcyclohexane、3-methyl-1-butene 和 4,4-dimethyl-1-pentene 等单体，并首次获得 isotactic poly(4,4-dimethyl-1-pentene)。
10.1002/anie.9519061.en: The study fine-tunes pyridylamido-Hf catalyst active sites so that highly hindered α-olefins that are otherwise difficult to polymerize can undergo selective polymerization to ultrahigh-melting polyolefins. Preactivation with allyltrimethylsilane enables monomers including vinylcyclohexane, 3-methyl-1-butene, and 4,4-dimethyl-1-pentene, giving the first isotactic poly(4,4-dimethyl-1-pentene).

10.1002/anie.8290035.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究发展催化分子内 N-heterocycle arylation 的 SNAr 方法，用于构建高张力大环、中等环 heterobiaryl atropisomer 及 atropopeptide。
10.1002/anie.8290035.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study develops catalytic intramolecular SNAr N-heterocycle arylation for highly strained macrocycles, medium-sized heterobiaryl atropisomeric rings, and atropopeptides.

10.1002/anie.3685338.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究设计带有可生物偶联手柄的 Ru(CAAC-5) 烯烃复分解催化剂，提高其在水相和生物相关条件下的稳定性与 RCM 活性。
10.1002/anie.3685338.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study designs a Ru(CAAC-5) olefin-metathesis catalyst bearing a bioconjugation handle, improving lifetime and ring-closing-metathesis activity under aqueous, biologically relevant conditions.

10.1002/anie.9855820.zh: 该研究以 Pd/C3N4 光催化剂和 D2O 实现可见光驱动的苄位 C(sp3)–H 氘代，可用于多类 alkyl(hetero)arene 和复杂分子的后期同位素标记。机理研究支持 Pd/C3N4 界面异裂 D2O 形成具有极性的 Pd–D / N–D 活性氘物种，并由此完成 H/D 交换。
10.1002/anie.9855820.en: The study uses a Pd/C3N4 photocatalyst and D2O for visible-light deuteration of benzylic C(sp3)–H bonds across diverse alkyl(hetero)arenes and complex molecules. Mechanistic studies support heterolytic D2O dissociation at the Pd/C3N4 interface to form polarized Pd–D and N–D active deuterium species that mediate H/D exchange.

10.1002/anie.5648702.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究把 NNP-pincer Fe(II)-dihydride 单核位点限制在多孔 Zr-MOF 中，用于 methane 和 ethane 的选择性单硼化。
10.1002/anie.5648702.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. A mononuclear NNP-pincer Fe(II)-dihydride is confined within a porous Zr-MOF for selective monoborylation of methane and ethane.

10.1002/anie.3415969.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究设计稳定的 oil/water/solid 三相界面 porous membrane electrode 反应器，使高浓度甚至 neat 有机底物可直接进行电有机合成，同时简化有机产物从水相电解质中的分离。
10.1002/anie.3415969.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. A porous-membrane-electrode reactor creates a stable oil/water/solid three-phase interface that allows concentrated or even neat organic reactants to undergo electro-organic synthesis while simplifying product separation from aqueous electrolyte.

10.1021/jacs.6c12391.zh: 该研究发展 Ni 催化对映选择性脱羧交叉偶联，将氨基酸或肽来源的 redox-active ester 与 silylzinc / germylzinc 试剂偶联，直接制备手性 α-silylamine 和 α-germylamine。反应底物范围广，并可用于肽和复杂分子的后期修饰；机理研究用于解析立体控制来源。
10.1021/jacs.6c12391.en: The study develops Ni-catalyzed enantioselective decarboxylative cross-coupling of amino-acid- or peptide-derived redox-active esters with silylzinc or germylzinc reagents to access chiral α-silylamines and α-germylamines. The reaction has broad scope and supports late-stage modification of peptides and complex molecules, while mechanistic studies probe the origin of stereocontrol.

10.1021/jacs.6c15393.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究完成 ecteinamycin 和 nonthmicin 的可放大全合成，关键步骤包括两次电化学脱羧烯基化、酶催化 anti-Baldwin 环化以及 redox-economic 的不对称 C–C 成键。
10.1021/jacs.6c15393.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study establishes scalable total syntheses of ecteinamycin and nonthmicin using two electrochemical decarboxylative alkenylations, an enzyme-catalyzed anti-Baldwin cyclization, and a redox-economic asymmetric C–C bond-forming step.

10.1021/jacs.6c13515.zh: 该研究发展 Rh 催化对映选择性 sila-(3+2) annulation，通过独特 1,2-silyl migration 将 alkynylsilane 的 C2Si 片段与 alkene 的 C2 片段模块化拼接，一步构建手性 silacyclopent-2-ene。方法覆盖多类官能化和复杂分子底物，并表现出很高立体控制；所得产物还可继续转化为含多个 C/Si stereogenic center 的饱和 silacycle。
10.1021/jacs.6c13515.en: The study develops Rh-catalyzed enantioselective sila-(3+2) annulation driven by an unusual 1,2-silyl migration, combining a C2Si fragment from an alkynylsilane with a C2 alkene fragment to form chiral silacyclopent-2-enes in one step. Diverse functionalized and complex substrates are tolerated with high stereocontrol, and the products can be diversified to saturated silacycles containing multiple carbon and silicon stereogenic centers.

10.1021/jacs.6c08653.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以 H-phosphonate diester dinucleotide 作为 ambiphilic blockmer，先在溶液相安装多样化磷酸骨架修饰，再通过固相方法组装为更长 oligonucleotide。
10.1021/jacs.6c08653.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Ambiphilic H-phosphonate diester dinucleotides are used as blockmers that can first receive diverse phosphate-backbone modifications in solution and then be assembled into longer oligonucleotides by solid-phase methods.

10.1021/jacs.6c15694.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究通过将传统 semicorrin 配体中的腈基替换为 perfluoroaryl，建立 scArF 配体家族，使缺乏近端配位/立体偏置的孤立二级碳自由基也能参与高对映选择性交叉偶联。
10.1021/jacs.6c15694.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. Replacing the conserved nitrile of semicorrin ligands with perfluoroaryl groups creates the scArF family, enabling highly enantioselective cross-coupling of isolated secondary carbon radicals that lack proximal coordinating or sterically differentiating functionality.

10.1021/jacs.6c13760.zh: 证据覆盖：partial；当前仅按已捕获内容总结。该研究以三类 building block 和三类 linker 的组合化学为基础，通过 tandem one-pot condensation 高效构建系统性的 NIR-II polymethine dye library。
10.1021/jacs.6c13760.en: Evidence coverage is partial; the summary is limited to captured material. The study combines three classes of building blocks with three linker types through tandem one-pot condensation to construct a systematic NIR-II polymethine dye library.
